items.label: Sturdy and Durable Frame
items.value: The patio furniture set features a superior metal frame with a powder-coated finish for enhanced durability and stability. The loveseat is rated to hold 700 lbs, a single sofa can hold up to 350 lbs

items.label: 4” Thick Deep Seating Cushion
items.value: The outdoor furniture set is padded with upgraded fillings, providing good support and maintain shape after use. The fabric on the cushions is removable and washable. Also the cushions have the Velcro to keep them from sliding around

items: Modern and Stylish Design：Faux wood table top has strong anti-scratch ability and is not easy to crack and deform. The faux wood arms give the set a clean and minimalist look

Wide Seat and Ergonomic Backrest：This patio conversation set is designed with good size and correct height to stand up from easily. The backrest of the set is designed ergonomically for providing good support to your hips and back

Easy to Assemble：This patio set is easy to set up. Each part has its own number on installation manual, so you can track assembly progress easily. The set comes delivered in 2 boxes at different times so be patient to wait that please
